item.title: Vio un remolque abandonado. Y descubrió una red de vigilancia en la frontera de California.
item.description: Los residentes del sur de California están notando nuevos lectores de matrículas que parecen ser operados por la Patrulla Fronteriza. Algunos han tenido encuentros confusos con los agentes.

item.title: Following CalMatters investigation, Congress finds data brokers cost consumers tens of billions of dollars
item.description: A congressional investigation estimates broker breaches have cost consumers $20 billion in identity theft. Major brokers now promise to make it easier to opt out of their databases.

item.title: Californians are staying insured — but settling for health coverage they may not use
item.description: Covered California enrollment fell 2.7% following the end of enhanced federal premium assistance. That’s better than expected, but many people are making concessions to afford staying insured.

item.title: Reform that re-traumatizes: California’s elderly parole program burdens victims, frightens the community
item.description: Under elderly parole, inmates 50 or older who served 20 years or more could be eligible for a parole hearing — regardless of how violent their crime was.

item.title: Trump’s war on immigrants repeats shameful chapter in America’s past
item.description: In the 1940s, U.S. politicians used racial prejudice and fear to justify deporting and detaining Japanese residents, including U.S. citizens. Today's playbook is similar.

item.title: Pockets of unvaccinated communities are driving measles outbreaks in California
item.description: California is battling measles across seven counties as federal funding cuts gut local health departments and vaccine skepticism fuels spread among unvaccinated children.

item.title: California GOP lawmakers are incensed over a gas tax study. Rural groups say they need it
item.description: California’s gas is so radioactive, even a bill to study alternatives is fraught. Rural officials are frustrated over the partisan fight because their local industries depend on well-maintained roads.

item.title: ‘Illegal, dangerous’: Newsom, CA Dems slam Trump on Iran
item.description: California Democrats slammed President Donald Trump over the weekend following his decision to launch a military attack on Iran on Saturday. Gov. item.title: Newsom threatens California counties for failing to use his new mental health court
item.description: Far fewer people with mental illness are getting help in Gov. Gavin Newsom’s CARE Court program than expected. This week, he blamed local governments for shortcomings.

item.title: California’s fire safety regulators are finally out with a ‘single stair’ report. They don’t love the idea
item.description: California’s fire safety regulators were asked to study whether mid-rise apartments can go with a single staircase. Their report takes a dim view of the notion.
